value.rationale: COTR is an advertised fairness axiom and is used in a central uniqueness characterization. The failure is systematic on the very multigrade domains the paper introduces: universal covariance survives exactly in the binary-grade specialization. The exact defect formula both diagnoses the proof error and supplies the full boundary of validity, so this is a meaningful structural correction rather than a routine numerical check.
